name: media-viewer
title: Media Viewer
description: An image, a video or a recording in a viewer, by its kind, in a viewer's frame. An image: on a checkerboard where it has transparent parts (found as it loads), flat (no corners, no shadow), fitted to the edges or zoomed (its percent in the toolbar, a menu of Fit, in, out and the steps; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel, + - and 0; under fingers a pinch about its middle as far as they go, not the page's, a double tap fitting it or zooming in to 200% there, a swipe across it fitted going to the one before or after, with its marking tools too while not marking), copied as a PNG, no status bar under it (its size and the app's facts at the top of More, compare at the toolbar's start), fitted and its size said before it loads where the app gives its width and height, its thumbnail over its placeholder standing in at its size till it is drawn; its versions in a strip of thumbnails under it picking the one shown (in a ViewerFrameTitlebar, a menu at the toolbar's start instead, the one shown in words), which is compared with the original by a line dragged between them (the facts saying when each was); one of the app's images, back and forth by buttons at its sides and the arrow keys, where it is ("30 of 60") in the facts, the comparison flat too, its divider and grip following the theme background; its areas brushed, circled or framed and sent to the app (onMark, markImages making the mask and an annotated copy), marks or a mask of what changed shown, its marking tools in the viewer's floating bar of edits, before the app's `edits` (on a ViewerFrameTitlebar's island under it instead, Mark first, then while marking its tools, Clear marks and the send there, not by the marks) ("Mark an area" in words, its icon alone where the viewer is narrow), drawn as when only looked at (no checkerboard for an opaque one, fitted to the edges, flat; a click zooms in a step). A video: on black, its controls over it in any theme (play, time, a seek bar showing the frame under the pointer, sound, full screen: the Fullscreen API, else the video alone in the system's player by webkitEnterFullscreen as on an iPhone, else no button), speed and loop below with its size and length. A recording: its title, a waveform of the app's peaks to seek on (a slider by keys too), and a transcript line by line, the line being said lit, each going there; speed, loop and copying the transcript below. Space plays and pauses, the arrows go 5 seconds; what cannot be shown or played says so. crossOrigin (e.g. use-credentials) and mediaProps give the app the element, to go to a time, and its events. Its image editor and comparison are its own files. Its position, onPrevious and onNext are the frame's (position { index, count }), for any kind: the buttons by its sides and "3 / 7" at its foot; an image's arrows and swipe go to them too.
